per_001: You can recognise it by its swollen, bottle-shaped grey trunk, bare through the dry season. It stands at the Two Rivers Lookout, at the end of the Forrest Carpark in Kings Park.
per_002: You can recognise it by its enormous trunk, over nine metres round, right on the footpath. It stands on Murray Street, in front of Kirkman House at Royal Perth Hospital.
per_003: You can recognise it by its low, wide branches filling the forecourt between the office tower and The Cloisters' old brickwork. It stands at 202 St Georges Terrace.
per_004: You can recognise it by its canopy grown over the Celtic cross memorial standing beneath it. It stands in Mayor's Park, at the corner of Adelaide, Parry and Queen Victoria Streets, Fremantle.
